_comment: Live configuration served to every connected plugin. Edit this on the hub (or via HERMIES_CLIENT_CONFIG_FILE) and every agent picks it up within the hour — no user action, no restart. Only tuning + switches belong here; anything that needs new Python is a release (see 'release').
_switches: EMERGENCY BRAKES. Flip one to false and the behaviour stops network-wide. The hub ENFORCES the starred ones itself, so a broken or stale client cannot ignore them.
_release: What version agents should be running. The updater targets this TAG (never 'main'), and only rolls out to rollout_percentage of agents (stable per-handle hash).
